name: ai-interviewer-practice
description: AI interview practice: backend (Express + MongoDB Atlas) and frontend (React) in separate folders

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
